scenes.title: 谁都能做饭！
quotes: But he could.
但是他可以学会。
Uh, no.
呃，不行。
How do you know? What do I always say? Anyone can cook.
你怎么知道？我常说什么？谁都能做饭。
Well, yeah, anyone can. That doesn't mean that anyone should.
嗯，对，谁都能做。可这不代表谁都应该做。
Well, that is not stopping him. See?
可这并没有让他停下来。看。

scenes.title: 你在吃那个？
quotes: What is that?
那是什么？
I don't really know.
我也不太清楚。
You don't know, and you're eating it?
你都不知道，还吃？
You know, if you can sort of muscle your way past the gag reflex, all kinds of food possibilities open up.
只要设法忍过想吐的感觉，各种食物都能接受了。

scenes.title: 餐厅又火了
quotes: What is it, Ambrister? Gusteau's finally closing, is it?
怎么了？古斯托餐厅终于要关门了吗？
No.
不是。
More financial trouble?
又有财务问题了？
No.
不是。
It's announced a new line of microwave egg rolls?
要推出新的微波春卷？
What?
什么？
What? Spit it out!
怎么了？快说！
It's come back. It's popular.
它又重新火起来了。

scenes.title: 慢慢尝尝味道
quotes: Close your eyes. Now take a bite of this. No, no. Don't just hork it down!
闭上眼睛，咬一口。别一口吞下去！
Here. Chew it slowly. Only think about the taste. See? Creamy, salty, sweet, an oaky nuttiness. You detect that?
给你，慢慢嚼。只想着它的味道。尝到了吗？奶油味、咸味、甜味和橡木果仁香。感觉到了吗？
Oh, I'm detecting nuttiness.
嗯，我确实感觉到果仁味了。
Close your eyes. Now taste this. A whole different thing, right? Sweet, crisp, slight tang on the finish.
闭上眼睛，尝尝这个。完全不一样吧？香甜清脆，回味有一丝酸味。

scenes.title: 来一点见解
quotes: Do you know what you would like this evening, sir?
先生，今晚您想点些什么？
Yes, I think I do. After reading a lot of overheated puffery about your new cook, you know what I'm craving? A little perspective. That's it.
我想好了。读了那么多对你们新厨师夸大的吹捧后，你知道我渴望什么吗？一点见解。
I'd like some fresh, clear, well-seasoned perspective. Can you suggest a good wine to go with that?
没错。我想要新鲜、清楚、调味得当的见解。能推荐一款搭配的葡萄酒吗？
With what, sir?
搭配什么，先生？
Perspective. Fresh out, I take it?
见解。看来已经没有了？
